video_subject: The Dark Forest Theory: Why aliens stay silent
video_script: The terrifying reason we have never heard from alien life is called the Dark Forest theory. Imagine the universe as a pitch-black forest at night. Every civilization is an armed hunter, stalking through the trees in dead silence. In this forest, survival is everything. If a hunter discovers another life form, they can never know if it is peaceful or hostile. So the only guaranteed way to survive is to eliminate them before they eliminate you. For seventy years, humanity has been shouting into the darkness, broadcasting radio signals into deep space like a helpless child screaming in the woods. And the reason nobody has ever answered is because every other hunter in the universe knows to keep their lights off and stay completely silent. Which is...
